question: Does the forward-transfer advantage grow as the retained skill library grows?
answer: No. Measured on eight paired seeds per rung, the advantage shrank from the third rung to the fourth and lost significance above the lowest accuracy target.
device: 2x NVIDIA RTX 5090, torch 2.12.0+cu130, runs verified bit-deterministic

estimator.primary: interpolated optimizer updates for a seed's held-out accuracy curve to first cross a fixed target, paired within seed across arms
estimator.secondary: paired held-out accuracy difference at every measured budget, with an exact sign test
estimator.rejection_reason: A step function over single runs on a coarse grid. It moved by up to twelve updates between mps and CUDA on bit-deterministic runs, i.e. it is knife-edge sensitive to floating-point rounding alone.

growth_comparison.conclusion: The fourth rung still shows a small, consistently signed advantage at the 85% target, but it is roughly a third the size of the third rung's and it vanishes at higher accuracy targets. There is no evidence of compounding acceleration across rungs.

interference_finding.observation: Among the 32 runs per arm at budgets of 768 or more, the richer three-skill ancestry failed the visible_context retention gate 14 times against the two-skill arm's 1.
interference_finding.interpretation: The nearest neighbour of the new composition is the direct-context skill, which the new cue distinguishes by a single bar. Each added rung raises the retention burden faster than it lowers the cost of the next skill, so retention, not learning speed, is the binding constraint as the library grows.

promoted.shuffled_retention_teacher_control: rejected; all three retentions fall to 0.4954-0.6090

open: The fourth primitive is mastered at two support outcomes. At one support it reaches only 0.569 in 2048 updates, so the one-support form of this rung is unreached; binary_mapping was originally acquired through the same graduated support reduction.

The two rungs differ in task family and budget scale (a zero-shot visible composition at tens of updates against a hidden-rule few-shot composition at hundreds), so the shrinking ratio is not a clean like-for-like comparison of rung depth alone.
Whether replay weighting or slot feature selection can hold the nearest-neighbour skill without slowing new acquisition.
claim_boundary: Two adjacent rungs, one task pair each, eight paired seeds per rung, one architecture. This bounds the growth of the transfer ratio in this ladder; it is not a general result about continual learning.
